note: Renames settings section/setting to project-ai-observability/ai-observability-byok, redirects legacy llm-analytics sections and rewrites legacy hash params, updates links.
Renames the flag key and collapses the if/else into a boolean plus one log line; groups and group_properties are still built by hand, no shared helper used.
Adds _enabled_ssh_tunnel helper used by the connection log, open_ssh_tunnel and make_ssh_tunnel_factory so all share one predicate; also logs db_port on errors.
Adds should_join_event_property helper and uses it both for the SELECT is_seen expression and the early return in the event-property join.
Drops summary, hypotheses, recommendations and tool-call fields from signal metadata and fixes weight to 1; no token-size helper is used.
Builds the skill file link via urls.aiObservabilitySkill with params and copies urls.absolute(urls.currentProject(path)) instead of window.location.origin.
Adds notificationDescribers registry; NotificationRow looks up a describer by notification and renders its component, else falls back to body.
Consolidates ceiling resolution into scopes.py (effective_ceiling, scopes_within_ceiling with wildcard flag) and has OAuth views call it, removing duplicated logic.
Replaces hand-rolled skeleton, empty state and list with CompactList using loading, emptyMessage, items and renderRow.
Makes generic Capture<T> and its methods pub(crate) for reuse by a new cascade sink, but CaptureSink in producer/mod.rs keeps its own duplicate recorder logic.
Replaces _group_type_name_aliases with _guarded_events_aliases that returns the union with EVENTS_LAZY_JOIN_ALIASES internally; caller uses it directly.
Removes DEFAULT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL, the interval field, and the interval, phase_id and reset_phase methods from PgSampler.
Moves REQUIRED_SLACK_SCOPES and bot_is_ready into new posthog/helpers/slack_scopes.py and imports them from there.
Drops the default for the days parameter of recent_count so callers must pass the window setting.
Moves queueInvocations back into the background task and adds a fatalError latch in KafkaConsumerV2 that blocks offset stores and stops the loop on task failure.
Adds a TODO in the trigger_cohort_backfill_task docstring about extracting backfill logic into a standalone function for all callers.
Changes SinkName FromStr error type from String to anyhow::Error, plus similar anyhow conversions in sink types.
Removes the inline Python outlier merge from the workflow and calls optimize_test_durations.py with a new --merge-files mode, with tests for the shared function.
Extracts resolve_effective_team_id in manager.py as the single resolver and uses it from both TeamScopedQuerySet and product_mixin.
Removes banned-construct AST checks from tool compile and rewrites docs to treat custom tools as trusted code with a planned ctx.native/ctx.mcp bridge; the bridge is not implemented.
